name: io.github.muradyf/layerbridge
title: Layerbridge
description: Read, edit and export the Figma file open in a local plugin. No REST API, no rate limits.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_BRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port the Figma plugin connects to; choose the same port in the plugin panel

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra folders export tools may write to (; on Windows, : elsewhere). Default: working directory only

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Figma personal access token; enables REST tools (comments, versions, team files)

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_BRIDGE_ALLOW_SCRIPTS
environmentVariables.description: Allow the run_script tool to execute Plugin API code in the open file
